verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms react.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the React documentation. Many cited docs pages are also served as markdown at .md URLs (e.g. /learn.md, /reference/react-dom/client/createRoot.md), which gives agents clean, machine-readable versions of the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using llms.txt or the .md docs effectively, and first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering.
